# blender-texture-baking

Bake texture maps in Blender 5.2 Cycles: high-to-low normal maps with cage or extrusion, AO, curvature, ID and thickness, base color, roughness and metallic converted from procedural materials, ORM packing, OpenGL vs DirectX conventions, and fixes for skewing, waviness and seams, with a preparation checklist that prevents most bake artifacts.
